arxiv-2304-11484.description: Abstract Photonic molecules – particular systems composed of coupled optical resonators – emulate the behavior of complex physical systems exhibiting discrete energy levels. arxiv-2305-00498.description: Abstract . By applying the derivative operator to the known identities from hypergeometric series or WZ pairs, we obtain seven series associated with harmonic numbers. Specifically, six of them are Ramanujan-like formulas for 1 / π 1/\pi and the remaining one contains harmonic numbers of order 2. As conclusions, Sun’s five conjectural series are proved.

arxiv-2412-09072.title: Cross-View Completion Models are Zero-shot Correspondence Estimators

arxiv-2412-09072.description: Abstract In this work, we explore new perspectives on cross-view completion learning by drawing an analogy to self-supervised correspondence learning.
